mapper.sql: select t.*, m.material_code as material_code, m.material_name as material_name, m.specification as specification, m.unit as unit from erp_purchase_order_item t left join erp_material m on m.id = t.material_id
mapper.select: where t.order_id = #{orderId} order by t.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into erp_purchase_order_item (order_id, material_id, quantity, received_quantity, unit_price, amount, create_by, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{materialId}, #{quantity}, ifnull(#{receivedQuantity},0), #{unitPrice}, #{amount}, ifnull(#{createBy},''), sysdate())
mapper.update: update erp_purchase_order_item set received_quantity = ifnull(received_quantity, 0) + #{quantity} where id = #{id}
